summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analyzing Soony's confidential launch data, finding where SAP/plan disagree with documents, and building a general agent product that detects, explains and acts on those problems.
summary.outcome: Found key contradictions (80,000 vs 8,000 art book receipt, failed statue lot, Hwaseong card shortfall, sleeve rev B vs C, false magnet alarm). Built the ask-soony platform: portal poller with versioned store, anchored-evidence cards, approval-gated supplier emails, Teams/push/voice alerts, a Monty-sandbox routines feature with recipe compiler, demo cards, and a UI redesign. 181 tests pass; many commits are still unpushed on jonas/alert-platform (PR #5).

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks or notifications; the only way to detect changes is polling and comparing per-file SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data, scans and notes live in the gitignored data/ folder; .env is gitignored and .env.example is committed with an empty SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN.

Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; tasks are claimed via a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md. Akshat owns the original UI (map, status strip, Rail), so changing his main view needs coordination.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; read-only turns log 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint'.

pydantic-monty sandbox type-checks routine code against provided functions before running, has no file or network access, and rejects imports like os. Free-form agent code was replaced by a structured recipe compiled to sandbox code, so the flow can be drawn automatically.

Routines may only carry out free options that communicate (email/message). Re-plans, allocations and orders are never automatic, because the earlier _costs_money check only read the cost text ('none') and was unsafe.

scripts/demo_cards.py seeds 7 demo cards from live portal data (only document references are fixed) and is idempotent; --reset backs up state files, clears decisions and switches routines off. Card deadlines can become overdue, so run it shortly before the demo.

code.finding: _costs_money treated an option as free when its cost text was empty or 'none', letting a routine execute an allocation decision; fixed by restricting routines to communication options and adding recipe validation and a compiler with an always-on brake.

Creates the Hwaseong, art book, statue and four PackRight sleeve demo cards, reading quantities, prices and dates from the portal at run time; checks PDFs still contain the expected text and merges by id.
Added the voice teach_routine tool (only on decided cards, stores a draft switched off in routine_drafts.json) and the GET /api/routines/drafts route.

workflow: Run one-off investigations as parallel subagents with narrow, independent briefs (UX, UI, jury devil's advocate, data scout) and merge the results; a scout's cross-check of 200 confirmations and 59 scans found the real discrepancies.

Before resetting live state, back up the state files and check what the user already did; confirm after the background loop ticks that the reset held (for example that a routine did not switch itself back on).
Verify UI changes with headless screenshots, and tell the user when a rendered page was not previewed.
Ask before pushing or sending anything outward-facing; commits stayed local until the user approves a push into PR #5.
Keep confidential data and secrets (portal token, webhook URL, user login) out of docs, commits and shared artifacts.

friction: Portal token was empty at the start, blocking data access until the user supplied it.
n8n's Sustainable Use License rules out building a sold product on it, which caused a detour through the team's automation ideas.
Sandbox type checker rejected the first compiled recipes (mixed text/dict types), so conversions had to be made explicit.
Fixed UI overlap: the Routines button covered the map legend and then the activity list, and 'Automate cards like this' was offered again for cards that already had a routine.
Dashboard contradictions (Collector's 'on track, −7 h slack' vs 32,000 at risk), raw codes like CMP-GAM-001 and a fake-position world map hurt credibility with the jury.
Whether portal data and supplier replies are identical across teams is undocumented, so it can't be assumed.
Teammates' files (api.ts, Routines.tsx) were off-limits to the backend builder, leaving frontend wiring to a second builder.

Wire activity[].via and GET /api/routines/drafts into web/src/lib/api.ts and Routines.tsx; finish the n8n-style flow view and the Routines builder.

Confirm with Lio whether the data is the same for all teams and whether supplier replies create portal files; consider changing the portal login password that was shared in Discord.
